svg.title: Spatial Omics Paper Reading workflow
svg.desc: Verify source — Check source access — Source and access; Trace design — Find units and contrasts — Design summary; Read figures — Read panels and captions — Evidence locations; Capture methods — Record settings and gaps — Methods log; Save report — Separate facts and views — Reading report
